tool_signatures.name: add_image
tool_signatures.description: Put an image on the timeline: import the still, place it with a real duration, and optionally position it.

tool_signatures.name: add_marker
tool_signatures.description: Add a timeline marker. Omit frame to use the current playhead; frame values are relative to timeline start.

tool_signatures.name: add_track
tool_signatures.description: Add one or more empty tracks. track_type is video, audio, or subtitle.

tool_signatures.name: animate_color_fx
tool_signatures.description: Animate dynamic color effects (rainbow hue rotation and subtle organic luminance flicker) over time via Fusion on a clip.

tool_signatures.name: animate_zoom
tool_signatures.description: Animate a clip's scale and framing over time (smooth zooms, punch-ins, rebounds, pull-outs, multi-keyframe paths).

tool_signatures.name: append_media
tool_signatures.description: Append video or audio to the timeline from media pool ids or absolute file paths.

tool_signatures.name: apply_blur_effect
tool_signatures.description: Apply a static or dynamic (gradual) blur effect to a full frame or masked bounding region on a timeline clip.

tool_signatures.name: apply_silence_cuts
tool_signatures.description: Remove USER-ACCEPTED silence intervals on a new duplicate timeline, retaining the original.

tool_signatures.name: apply_spotlight_mask
tool_signatures.description: Apply a dynamic or static spotlight reveal mask with adjustable feathering, ambient darkness, and animated sweep keyframes.

tool_signatures.name: bridge_capabilities
tool_signatures.description: Report Resolve version, transport, API presence and source decoder availability.

tool_signatures.name: change_clip_speed
tool_signatures.description: Change constant video speed through a bridge-owned Fusion TimeSpeed node.

tool_signatures.name: compare_timelines
tool_signatures.description: Compare two timelines by unique ID or exact name without changing the active timeline.

tool_signatures.name: create_compound_clip
tool_signatures.description: Create a compound clip combining one or more timeline items into a single container clip.

tool_signatures.name: create_timeline
tool_signatures.description: Create and open a new empty timeline with an exact name.

tool_signatures.name: delete_clips
tool_signatures.description: Delete timeline items. Refuses unless the user explicitly approved this destructive action in the current conversation.

tool_signatures.name: delete_marker
tool_signatures.description: Delete the timeline marker at a frame relative to timeline start.

tool_signatures.name: get_clip_grade
tool_signatures.description: Inspect color grading nodes, versions, and Fusion compositions on a clip.

tool_signatures.name: get_clip_transform
tool_signatures.description: Read the current position, scale, rotation, crop, opacity, and blend mode of one timeline item.

tool_signatures.name: import_media
tool_signatures.description: Import existing local media files by absolute path into the Media Pool. This does not place them on the timeline.

tool_signatures.name: insert_title
tool_signatures.description: Insert a title at the playhead on the current video track, best effort.

tool_signatures.name: keyframe_clip_saturation
tool_signatures.description: Animate a gradual color transition (e.g. from 1.0 full color to 0.0 black and white) across frames via Fusion BezierSpline on the clip.

tool_signatures.name: list_media
tool_signatures.description: List media pool items recursively with unique ids, bin paths, file paths, frame counts, and durations.

tool_signatures.name: list_render_presets
tool_signatures.description: List the render presets and formats available in this project, for use with render_current_timeline.

tool_signatures.name: list_timelines
tool_signatures.description: List every timeline in the open project and identify the current one.

tool_signatures.name: open_page
tool_signatures.description: Switch the Resolve window to a page so the user can see a change: media, cut, edit, fusion, color, fairlight, or deliver.

tool_signatures.name: open_timeline
tool_signatures.description: Open a timeline by unique ID, exact name or one-based index from list_timelines.

tool_signatures.name: preview_timeline
tool_signatures.description: Duplicate and open the active timeline for reviewing edits while retaining the original.

tool_signatures.name: project_health
tool_signatures.description: Inspect active-timeline missing sources, gaps, disabled/locked tracks and clips.

tool_signatures.name: project_info
tool_signatures.description: Return the current project's name, timeline, frame rate, resolution, and timeline count.

tool_signatures.name: render_current_timeline
tool_signatures.description: Add a render job for the current timeline. Starting the render requires explicit user approval.

tool_signatures.name: resolve_status
tool_signatures.description: Check how the bridge is connected, plus the Resolve version, open project, and timeline. Always call this first.

tool_signatures.name: review_silence
tool_signatures.description: Analyze source audio for a clip and place yellow review markers; never deletes clips.

tool_signatures.name: save_project
tool_signatures.description: Save the current Resolve project.

tool_signatures.name: set_clip_color
tool_signatures.description: Set a standard Resolve clip color, or pass an empty string to clear it.

tool_signatures.name: set_clip_enabled
tool_signatures.description: Enable or disable one timeline item without deleting it.

tool_signatures.name: set_clip_grade
tool_signatures.description: Apply ASC-CDL color grading (saturation, slope/gain, offset/lift, power/gamma) to a clip. Pass saturation=0.0 for black & white.

tool_signatures.name: set_clip_property
tool_signatures.description: Set any documented Resolve timeline item property directly. Prefer set_clip_transform for common changes.

tool_signatures.name: set_clip_transform
tool_signatures.description: Position, scale, rotate, fade, crop, or blend one timeline item.

tool_signatures.name: set_playhead
tool_signatures.description: Move the current timeline playhead. Use HH:MM:SS:FF matching the timeline frame rate.

tool_signatures.name: set_track_name
tool_signatures.description: Rename one track, for example labelling V2 as Overlays.

tool_signatures.name: split_clip
tool_signatures.description: Split a normal-speed clip at an absolute frame/timecode after creating a timeline checkpoint.

tool_signatures.name: timeline_audio
tool_signatures.description: Analyze selected source PCM, excluding Fairlight gain, fades, mute and the timeline mix.

tool_signatures.name: timeline_frame
tool_signatures.description: Return a native MCP image of the requested absolute timeline frame or timecode.

tool_signatures.name: timeline_overview
tool_signatures.description: Inspect stable unique clip IDs, positional labels, tracks, frame ranges and markers. Call before and after edits.
